notes: INSIDE half of the Kett Drone Picket: a rack of five drone cells; each drone wakes and lights up as it charges (frame 5 = five awake, cells green), power coupling, hatch. fire: the cells flash and the drones are gone. damaged: a cell cracked and dark, a drone stuck half out; disabled: drones dead and grey. Barrel layer kett_drone_picket_barrel: a round chitin dome with two open drone bays, compound-eye blobs on the front and a launch slit; fire: the drones leave the bays.
